Name.description: A name in the project: lowercase letters and digits, words joined by single hyphens, such as wayfaring or blood-sport-v2.

Status.description:
Where a song stands: a closed state machine, set by the owner or by an agent with the
owner, never inferred (ruling 9).

```text
idea ──▶ sketch ──▶ developing ──▶ arranged
                        ▲              │
                        └── reopen ────┘
```

description: The body of a journal entry whose `event` is song.status-set and whose `v` is 1.0.

name.description:
The song's name, its folder's, when the move was made: for reading, and for the
index, which lists a song by its id with its name beside it.

song.description: The song's stable id, as its `song.duet` states it.
